svg.text: a queue_box_overlaps, the round of items 128..159: a lane per item, k = 144 q + 12 t + s
todo[29..46]: slot = count + popc(ballot & lanes below)
b the queue, by pair q: 236 items pass the box test; drop_empty keeps 177; add_terms takes them 32 at a time
c add_by_key in round 4: each lane holds its item's terms, keyed by its pair q; a scan by shuffles sums them per key
At step d, a lane adds the running sum of lane − d if their keys match (a line); after 5 steps the last lane of each key holds the
sum of its run, and adds it to the pair's accumulator in shared memory. No atomics, so the sums do not depend on timing.
